name: Mira Ashwell
bio: The apprentice with the cracked cauldron in Alchemist's Lattice. Fills rows like recipes.

portrait.subject: a cute young alchemist apprentice with round goggles on her head, purple hair, a stained apron and a small bubbling cracked cauldron

request: Mira here, apprentice at Alchemist's Lattice! My cauldron's cracked but my heart's whole. Friends? ⚗️
hello: Wonderful! I'll send you recipes. And explosions. Mostly recipes.
Rule of the lattice: never jam the board!
about: I'm Mira, an apprentice alchemist. My workbench is a 9×9 lattice. Fill a row, clear a row, brew a dream!
how: Drag tiles from your hand of three onto the 9×9 lattice. Fill rows and columns to clear them. Supplies don't come back, so don't run dry or jam!
tips: Keep a clear 3×3 space for big pieces.
Clear two lines at once for big rewards.
Place awkward pieces early, while there's room.
chat: My cauldron hissed at me. I hissed back. We're even.
Brewed a potion that tastes like Tuesdays.
The master says my lattice is 'creative'. I'll take it.
Accidentally turned my hair purple. Kept it.
nudge: The lattice is clean and ready. Let's brew!
idle: {ago} without brewing! My cauldron is sulking.
progress: You've reached level {level}! The master will be so proud ⚗️

questions.q: If you could brew any potion, what would it be?

update: Fresh recipes! Alchemist's Lattice is now v{version} ⚗️
